description: Set one or more environment variables on a running service. For cost preview call with dry_run: true first.

auth_token.description: Optional. Deployment-scoped JWT returned by a prior wallet-signed cp_deploy. Overrides the operator Bearer for this call — required to manage services created via the x402 wallet-only flow.

confirm_token.description: Confirm token returned by a prior dry_run call. Required for destructive tools.

dry_run.description: If true, validate inputs and return a planned action + confirm_token without mutating state. Call again with the returned confirm_token to execute.

name: cp_env_set
